result.title: The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information
result.summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapts a frozen language model through a compact learned update, making it a natural setting for asking how much information fine-tuning needs to write. Yet adapter rank, parameter count, or numerical reconstruction error do not directly tell us how many bits are required to preserve the acquired behavior. We therefore define an operational behavioral rate $R^\star$ as the smallest serialized size of a compressed adapter that, once reloaded into the frozen base model, retains a fixed fraction of its held-out fine-tuning gain. Across LoRA fine-tuning experiments, this rate increases with distinct training content at fixed optimization budgets, but is not determined by intuitive metrics like source description length, fine-tuning gain, or weight-space reconstruction error. Most importantly, the same datasets exhibit substantially different, and even reordered, rates across frozen base models, showing that fine-tuning compressibility is a property of the dataset--receiver pair rather than of the dataset alone. However, we show that correction spectra measured on the data are able to rank these rates within a receiver. Finally, we study a striking noise-reducing effect of compression: adapters trained on deliberately corrupted datasets fall far below the frozen model, yet after compression score above it (23.7% to 82.9% on GSM8K, against 77.6% for frozen Qwen2.5-7B), consistently across tested families and sizes. The damage is unevenly concentrated in the adapter's leading singular directions, which compression appears to filter. Away from its training task, the compressed corrupted adapter also generalizes better than a clean fine-tune: on harder math it retains 97% of base accuracy, versus 44% for the clean adapter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出操作性的「行为速率」R*，即以重新载入冻结基座后仍能保留固定比例微调增益的最小压缩适配器序列化大小来度量微调写入的有用信息，发现该速率由数据集与基座模型共同决定，并观察到压缩能滤除集中在适配器主导奇异方向上的噪声，使损坏数据训练的适配器反而在压缩后超过基座模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以压缩后行为保持量衡量有用信息、区分任务必要成分与噪声」的操作化思路，可能为量化 latent 推理状态或适配增量中的有效信息与信息坍缩提供测量线索，可供核查；但原文限于纯文本 LoRA，迁移到视觉推理状态还需较多验证。
